mapping: One cleaned viewer page for each original PDF page; page numbers are identical.

cleanup.method: Deterministic photographed-content crop, grayscale conversion, conservative autocontrast, and mild unsharp masking.
cleanup.deskew: No automatic rotation was applied where a safe angle could not be established; original photographic geometry is preserved.
